lines.en: I scurry low along the ground.
Six short legs work together.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳在碎石上磕响。
lines.en: My shell knocks on the gravel.
I squeeze through a crack and run on.
I circle a chunk of originium.
I shuffle forward in bursts.
My antennae test the air.
I cross a patch of crystal dust.
I follow the line of the vein.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地面上很小。
lines.en: My shadow is small on the ground.
I crawl to your foot, then back away.
I climb a stretch of wall.
I climb down the edge of the pit.
I go around a sharp crystal.

lines.zh: 我在石头底下歇了一会儿。
lines.en: I rest under a stone a while.
I lie still on the stone.
My mouthparts open and close.
There is ore dust on my shell.

lines.zh: 我缩起腿，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I draw my legs in and pass for a stone.
At this size I am easy to miss.
I change angle, legs first.

lines.zh: 我发现了一条新的裂缝。
lines.en: I have found a new crack.
My antennae touch the ore.
I wait for the vein to glow a little.
I could stay here all day.
You are sixty times my size.

lines.zh: 你指缝里的铁屑，够我吃一顿。
lines.en: The iron filings between your fingers are a meal to me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看到你的靴子。
lines.en: I raise my head and see your boot.
Are you thinking of keeping me?
I bite; do not underestimate me.

lines.zh: 我认得你喂过我的味道。
lines.en: I know the smell of the one who fed me.
I can smell the iron you carry.
The ore is this way; you are going wrong.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的一块石头。
lines.en: You crushed one of my stones.
I circled you, half a turn.
Do you want me to follow you?
I curl up; my shell hurts.

lines.zh: 这一下差点碾碎我的壳。
lines.en: That nearly crushed my shell.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口空气，没咬到。
lines.en: I bite at air and miss.
My legs are still trembling.
A line has cracked across my shell.
I shake and ore dust falls.
That blow was far too heavy.
I am still here, not broken.
I edge backward.
I like the tang of iron.
Give me that ore.
Don't step on it; I will take it.
Let me lick it first.
Leave it there and don't move.
I push it back to my nest.
This taste will make me grow.
I eat fast; don't take it.
You stepped on me and I curled.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴子上，弹开。
lines.en: I bounce off your boot.
That nearly crushed me.

lines.zh: 颚钳夹住你的鞋尖不放。
lines.en: My jaw-clamps hold fast to your boot tip.
I retreat into a crack.
Did you feel me?
There is a new mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后我晕了一会儿。
lines.en: The collision left me dazed.
That depends on how big I grow.
There are many of my kind in the ore.
I am small, but I know how to look.
That question is too big for me.
I wave my antennae.
Ore first; then we can talk.
I need to eat a while longer.
I am the only one here.
I duck under the stone.
I will set that subject aside.
I hold it with both front feet.
I drag it backward.
I bite down and lift.
Too small; it slipped.
I taste it; very hard.
I cannot lift it; I can only push.
I will store it and eat slowly.
Hold me if you like, but not my jaws.
Something stirs under the gravel.
My antennae point that way.
All my antennae point forward.
That thing is a little smaller than me.
I flatten, ready to charge.
Its smell is new.
I come out of the crack.
This stretch of vein is mine.

lines.zh: 它的每一下落地我都数。
lines.en: I count every landing it makes.
It stepped on my stone.
These small jaws are for gnawing originium.
Now; here I come.
I follow along the wall.
It runs where the ore is thick.
I come around its flank.
It has not noticed how small I am.
It leapt; I withdrew.

lines.zh: 我贴着矿渣爬，它没听见。
lines.en: I crawl along the slag, and it never hears me.
It has run to the pit's edge.
I wait beneath its feet.

lines.zh: 我钻进它的影子，等机会。
lines.en: I slip into its shadow and wait.
When it stops, I pounce.
I bite its ankle.
My mouthparts are small but hard.
It lifts a foot; I dodge.
I climb its leg.
It kicks and I fly off.
I clamp onto its hide and hold.
I am shaken off and hit the ground.
I climb up once more.
At last it backs away.
I guard this chunk of ore.

lines.zh: 我从矿堆的缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a gap in the ore heap.
There is plenty to eat here.

lines.zh: 我只有二十点血，得小心。
lines.en: Only twenty points; I must be careful.
The vein's glow falls on my shell.
First I look for a stone.
The smells here are fresh.
I circle once to learn the paths.
I begin digging my burrow.

lines.zh: 我从坑边摔下去，滚了几圈。
lines.en: I fall from the pit edge and roll.
Water fills the seams of my shell.
The blast throws me two meters.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我的壳钉在地上。
lines.en: An arrow pins my shell to the ground.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的腿全麻了。
lines.en: That force numbs all my legs.
No ore to eat; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整只都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I light up.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，腿在空中乱蹬。
lines.en: I fall, legs kicking at the air.
